blocks.prompt:
1 Define excretion. Describe the three essential roles of the urinary system and the position of its organs in the body. (4 marks)
(Excretion ki tareef karein. Urinary system ke teen bunyadi kaam aur jism mein is ke organs ki jagah bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Excretion woh amal hai jis mein jandar metabolic fuzlaat (nitrogeni fuzlaat, zaid pani, zaid namak) kharij karta hai.

Urinary system ke kaam:
1. Nitrogeni fuzlaat: urea chhaanna jo liver mein protein tootne se banta hai.
2. Osmoregulation: pani wapas lene ya nikalne ki miqdar badal kar khoon mein pani aur namak ka tawazun.
3. pH aur ions: sodium, potassium aur hydrogen ions ka tawazun taa ke khoon thora basic (taqreeban pH 7.4) rahe.

Organs ki jagah:
1. Do gurde: pait ki cavity mein oopar, reerh ki haddi ke dono taraf, 12th thoracic aur 3rd lumbar vertebrae ke darmiyan; liver ki wajah se daayan thora neeche aur chhota; oopri hisse 11th aur 12th pasliyan bachati hain.
2. Do ureters: taqreeban 25 cm, renal pelvis se bladder tak.
3. Urinary bladder: pelvic cavity mein khokhla, phailne wala muscular organ; peshab ka zakheera.
4. Urethra: peshab bladder se bahar le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The human urinary system consists of two kidneys, two ureters, one urinary bladder, and one urethra

blocks.prompt:
2 Describe the renal corpuscle of a nephron. Compare the two types of nephrons. (4 marks)
(Nephron ke renal corpuscle ko bayan karein. Nephrons ki do qismon ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Har gurde mein taqreeban das lakh nephrons hain jo functional units hain; har aik mein renal corpuscle aur renal tubule hai. Renal corpuscle ke do hisse hain: glomerulus, afferent renal arteriole se banne wala capillaries ka jaal, aur Bowman's capsule, glomerulus ko gherne wali piyala numa dohri deewar wali thaili.

(ii) Jagah ki bunyad par nephrons cortical ya juxtamedullary hain; muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Nephrons are categorized into two types based on their location within the kidney

blocks.prompt:
3 Trace the pathway of blood through the kidney from the renal artery to the inferior vena cava. (4 marks)
(Gurde mein khoon ka rasta renal artery se inferior vena cava tak bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gurde bohat vascularized hain; dil ke output ka taqreeban 20–25% lete hain.
1. Renal artery hilum se dakhil ho kar shakhon mein batti hai jin se afferent arterioles banti hain.
2. Har afferent arteriole glomerulus (capillary bed) mein jati hai.
3. Aksar capillaries venules mein khulti hain, magar glomerular capillaries efferent arteriole mein.
4. Efferent arteriole peritubular capillaries banati hai jo cortex mein proximal aur distal tubules ke gird ghana jaal hain. Juxtamedullary nephrons mein vasa recta bhi banti hain: medulla mein loops of Henle ke mutawazi lambi seedhi capillaries.
5. Tabadle ke baad capillaries mil kar venules aur phir bari veins banati hain jo renal vein mein khulti hain.
6. Renal vein hilum se nikal kar inferior vena cava mein khulti hai aur saaf khoon dil ko le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The pathway of blood inside kidney begins with the renal artery, which enters the kidney at the hilum

blocks.prompt:
4 Explain how high pressure is produced in the glomerulus and what it achieves. Which substances enter the filtrate and which remain in blood? (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke glomerulus mein zyada pressure kaise banta hai aur is ka kya natija hai. Kaun se maddy filtrate mein jate aur kaun se khoon mein rehte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Glomerular filtration (ultrafiltration) peshab banne ka pehla qadam aur tabai amal hai.
1. Pressure ki wajah: efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerular capillaries mein khoon zyada pressure mein rehta hai.
2. Natija: yeh pressure khoon ke maye hisse ko Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai. Maye hisse ka taqreeban panchwan hissa (20%) chhanta hai; yeh glomerular filtrate hai.

Maddon ka muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The first step in the formation of urine is a physical process known as glomerular filtration

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe what is reabsorbed in each part of the renal tubule during selective reabsorption, and by which method. (4 marks)
(Selective reabsorption mein renal tubule ke har hisse mein kya aur kis tareeqe se wapas jazb hota hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Selective reabsorption mufeed maddon ko renal tubule se peritubular capillaries mein wapas karta hai, kyun ke filtrate mein fuzlaat ke saath zaroori ghizai ajza bhi hain.
1. Proximal convoluted tubule (sab se zyada): taqreeban 75% pani osmosis se; glucose, amino acids aur namak (sodium, potassium, calcium) active transport se.
2. Loop of Henle ka descending limb: mazeed pani.
3. Ascending limb: pani ke liye band, namak active transport se bahar.
4. Distal convoluted tubule: kuch pani aur namak.
5. Collecting duct: pani ke wapas jazb hone ki aakhri jagah.

book_ref.quote: Most reabsorption occurs in the proximal convoluted tubule

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain tubular secretion and its importance. Describe the path by which the urine formed leaves the body. (4 marks)
(Tubular secretion aur is ki ahmiyat wazeh karein. Bane hue peshab ke jism se nikalne ka rasta bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Tubular secretion reabsorption ka ulat hai: tubule ke epithelial cells ird gird ke khoon se maddy le kar filtrate mein dalte hain. Maddy: hydrogen ions, ammonium, potassium ions aur toxins ya dawa ke baqiye (jaise penicillin). Hydrogen ions secrete kar ke gurde khoon ka acid-base tawazun (pH) rakhte hain.

(ii) Peshab ka rasta: kai nephrons ki DCTs collecting duct mein; collecting ducts mil kar papillary ducts jo renal pelvis mein khulti hain; pelvis se ureter aur ureter se bladder; bladder ke muscles sukerh kar peshab urethra se bahar nikalte hain. Normal baaligh rozana 1 se 2 litre peshab kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In this process, the epithelial cells of the distal convoluted tubule take some materials from surrounding blood

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain the factors that change the volume of urine. How do kidneys act as osmoregulatory organs? (4 marks)
(Peshab ki miqdar badalne wale awamil wazeh karein. Gurde osmoregulatory organs ke taur par kaise kaam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Normal baaligh rozana 1 se 2 litre peshab kharij karta hai magar miqdar badalti hai:
1. Pani: jitna zyada pani ya mashroob, utna zyada peshab.
2. Namak: zyada namak pani rokta aur peshab kam karta hai.
3. Warzish: saans aur paseene se pani nikalta hai, peshab kam.
4. Garam mausam: paseene se zyada pani nikalta hai, gurde pani bachate aur kam garha peshab banate hain.

(ii) Excretion ke saath gurde jism ke fluids ka namak bhi control karte hain: fluids hypotonic hon (zyada pani) to patla (hypotonic) peshab, aur hypertonic hon (pani ki kami) to garha (hypertonic) peshab. Yeh kaam ADH aur aldosterone chalate hain.

book_ref.quote: The more water or hydrating fluids we consume, the higher is the urine output

blocks.prompt:
8 Explain how the different permeability of the two limbs of the loop of Henle keeps the surrounding fluid salty, and how this helps water reabsorption from the collecting duct. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke loop of Henle ke do limbs ki mukhtalif permeability ird gird ke fluid ko namkeen kaise rakhti hai aur is se collecting duct se pani kaise wapas aata hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Loop of Henle aur collecting duct se pani lene ke liye nephrons counter-current mechanism se ird gird ke fluid mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar banate aur rakhte hain.
1. Descending limb: pani ke liye khula, namak ke liye band. Filtrate neeche jata hai to pani namkeen fluid mein nikal jata hai.
2. Ascending limb: pani ke liye band magar sodium ions active taur par bahar bhejta hai; chloride ions peeche jate hain. Is liye fluid ka namak zyada rehta hai.
3. Collecting duct: peshab is namkeen fluid se guzarta hai to pani osmosis se nikal kar vasa recta ke zariye khoon mein jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When filtrate flows through the descending limb, water is reabsorbed into the surrounding fluid

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Descending limb sirf pani chhorta hai aur ascending limb sirf namak; is tarah medulla ka fluid hamesha namkeen rehta hai aur collecting duct se pani kheench leta hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the role of ADH when the body is dehydrated and when the blood salt concentration falls. What is diabetes insipidus? (4 marks)
(Pani ki kami aur khoon mein namak kam hone par ADH ka kirdar bayan karein. Diabetes insipidus kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
ADH jism mein pani bachane ka bunyadi zariya hai; hypothalamus banata aur posterior pituitary kharij karta hai.

(i) Pani ki kami ya namkeen khana: hypothalamus ke osmoreceptors khoon mein namak ki zyadti mehsoos karte hain. Hypothalamus pyaas paida karta (thirst centre) aur posterior pituitary ko ADH chhorne ka ishara deta hai. ADH collecting ducts ki deewarein pani ke liye zyada khuli karta hai; zyada pani filtrate se hypertonic fluid aur phir khoon mein jata hai. Garha peshab banta aur pani bachta hai. ADH khoon ki miqdar barhata aur naliyan tang karta hai, BP barhta hai.

(ii) Namak kam hone par: hypothalamus ADH band karta hai; deewarein kam khuli, kam pani wapas aur patla peshab; khoon ki miqdar aur BP kam.

Diabetes insipidus: pituitary ke nuqsan se kafi ADH na banane wala shakhs musalsal bohat patla peshab kharij karta hai aur shadeed pani ki kami aur bohat kam BP ka khatra hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The hypothalamus sends signals to the posterior pituitary to create a sensation of thirst and to release ADH

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq posterior pituitary pyaas paida karta hai; sahi baat yeh hai ke pyaas hypothalamus khud paida karta hai aur posterior pituitary sirf ADH chhorta hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
10 Describe the role of aldosterone in kidney function and compare it with ADH. (4 marks)
(Gurdon ke kaam mein aldosterone ka kirdar bayan karein aur ADH se muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aldosterone peshab mein sodium aur potassium ki miqdar regulate karta hai. Ise adrenal cortex banata hai jo gurde ke oopar adrenal gland ki bahar wali teh hai.
1. BP gire ya khoon mein sodium bohat kam ho to kharij hota hai.
2. DCT aur collecting duct ki deewaron par asar kar ke sodium ions filtrate se khoon mein wapas karwata hai.
3. Khoon mein sodium zyada hone se pani bhi filtrate se khoon mein jata hai.
4. Potassium ions peshab mein nikalwata hai aur hyperkalaemia (khoon mein zyada potassium jo dil ki khatarnak be-tarteeb dharkan karta hai) se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: Aldosterone is the hormone responsible for regulating sodium and potassium levels of urine

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the cause, spread, symptoms and treatment of urinary tract infections. (4 marks)
(Urinary tract infections ki wajah, phailao, alamaat aur ilaj bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Wajah: aam taur par bacteria, zyada tar Escherichia coli.
2. Phailao: bacteria urethra se dakhil ho kar bladder, ureters ya gurdon ko infect karte hain.
3. Alamaat: bar bar aur fori peshab ki hajat, peshab mein dard ya jalan, gadla ya tez boo wala peshab, pait ke nichle hisse mein dard, kabhi bukhar ya kapkapi.
4. Ilaj: bacteria marne ke liye antibiotics ka course; zyada pani peena aur bar bar peshab karna bacteria nikalne aur alamaat kam karne mein madad deta hai.

book_ref.quote: These bacteria enter the urinary system through urethra and infect the bladder, ureters, or kidneys

blocks.explanation: Lithotripsy gurde ki pathri torna hai jo pathri ka aam ilaj hai. Is ke do tareeqon ka muqabla table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two methods of lithotripsy

blocks.prompt:
13 What is kidney failure? Describe the possible causes of acute kidney failure and explain why chronic failure needs dialysis or a transplant. (4 marks)
(Kidney failure kya hai? Acute kidney failure ki mumkina wajuhaat bayan karein aur wazahat karein ke chronic failure mein dialysis ya transplant kyun chahiye.)

book_ref.quote: Acute kidney failure (also called kidney injury) occurs suddenly and often resolves with treatment

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the steps of peritoneal dialysis. Why must it be repeated several times a day? (4 marks)
(Peritoneal dialysis ke qadam bayan karein. Yeh din mein kai bar kyun dohraya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Peritoneal dialysis mein pait ki cavity ki parat (peritoneal membrane) filter ka kaam karti hai.
1. Catheter se 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate pait mein dala jata hai.
2. Dialysate pait mein 4 se 6 ghante rakha jata hai.
3. Peritoneum ki capillaries se fuzlaat aur zaid pani dialysate mein aa jate hain.
4. Dialysate pait se nikal kar phenk diya jata hai.
5. Fuzlaat aur zaid pani ki kafi safai ke liye yeh din mein kai bar dohraya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This process is repeated several times a day, to achieve adequate clearance of waste products and excess fluid

blocks.prompt:
15 Describe the potential donors for kidney transplant and the matching needed for each. Is donating a kidney harmful to the donor? (4 marks)
(Kidney transplant ke mumkina donors aur har aik ke liye zaroori milan bayan karein. Kya gurda dena donor ke liye nuqsandeh hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Mumkina donors:
1. Rishtedar donor: recipient ka jeeni rishtedar, jaise walidain, behan bhai ya aulad; behtareen donor ho sakta hai.
2. Ghair rishtedar donor: jeeni rishta nahi, jaise shareek-e-hayat, dost ya saathi mulazim; kam aam magar blood group aur tissue type milne par kamyab.
3. Deceased donor: log jo maut ke baad aaza dene ke liye hospitals mein register hote hain; in ke gurde blood group, tissue type aur immune system ki mutabiqat se milaye jate hain.

Donor par asar: end-stage kidney disease wale ke liye gurda zindagi bachane wala tohfa hai. Is se donor ki sehat ko lambe arse ka koi bara khatra nahi; tehqeeq ke mutabiq donor ki sehat aur umr par manfi asar nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: Deceased donor's kidneys are carefully matched to recipients based on blood group, tissue type, and immune system compatibility
